name: g75_clefable_magic_bounce
purpose: Clefablite (step G75): Clefable (F) with its hidden ability Unaware Mega Evolves on turn 1 into Clefable-Mega (Magic Bounce, Fairy/Flying). Skeledirge's Will-O-Wisp, a reflectable status move, is bounced back at Skeledirge (Fire type, so the burn itself is refused) and Clefable's Moonblast then hits Skeledirge.
